'''Veag Gonwa''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.4}}</ref> Gonwa was part of [[Strike Team Oricon]], a unit sent to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Oricon]] to confront the powerful rogue [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] known as the [[Dread Masters]].<ref name="TOR" /> A [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] with a [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|ponytail]], gray [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and tan skin with brown [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] on their face, Gonwa wore the dark gray [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with orange and white markings that most of the strike team wore. Gonwa sold armor and weaponry, and they often practiced with their green [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] using [[Remote/Legends|training remotes]] at [[Strike Team Oricon camp|their camp]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
An armor vendor for the Jedi Knight class on Oricon, Gonwa was introduced<ref name="TOR" /> on [[October 1]], [[2013]],<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/2.4.0/dread-war|text=Game Update 2.4: The Dread War Patch Notes}}</ref> in Game Update 2.4 for the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''. Gonwa and the rest of the class gear vendors at Oricon, along with all other Daily Areas and high-level planets, were replaced by standardized vendors in Game Update 4.0<ref name="TOR" /> on [[October 20]], [[2015]];<ref name="Patch4">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Gonwa was replaced by Master [[Vikto]].<ref name="TOR" />
